author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Travis d'Arnaud (foot) completing light on-field activities
desc: Travis d'Arnaud has progressed to completing light on-field activities.
impact: D'Arnaud has been sidelined since May 7 due to right foot plantar fasciitis. He is no longer wearing a walking boot and has progressed to playing catch and light on-field activities. There is still no clear timeline for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Yusei Kikuchi (shoulder) playing catch
desc: Yusei Kikuchi recently began his throwing program and has progressed to playing catch.
impact: Kikuchi has been sidelined since May 3 due to left shoulder inflammation. He will continue progressing through his throwing program, but fantasy managers should not expect him to return until after the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Grayson Rodriguez (back) throwing off flat ground
desc: Grayson Rodriguez threw off flat ground on Saturday and Sunday.
impact: Rodriguez exited his June 14 start against the Tampa Bay Rays in the third inning due to lower back tightness. An MRI came back clean, and he has since resumed throwing off flat ground. If he continues to progress, he could be activated from the injured list before the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Logan Henderson (back) to throw live BP Tuesday
desc: Logan Henderson threw a live batting practice session on Sunday and is scheduled for another one on Tuesday.
impact: Henderson has been sidelined since April 26 due to a lower back strain. If he responds well to Tuesday's live batting practice session, he is expected to begin a minor league rehab assignment shortly thereafter. Henderson remains on track to be reinstated from the injured list in early July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kris Bubic (elbow) throws bullpen session Sunday
desc: Kris Bubic threw a two-up bullpen session on Sunday.
impact: Bubic, who was on a minor league rehab assignment while recovering from an elbow injury, suffered a setback with a shoulder issue on June 9. He threw a bullpen session on Sunday and could resume his rehab assignment if he recovers well.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bailey Ober (elbow) throws bullpen session Saturday
desc: Bailey Ober threw a bullpen session Saturday with no ill effects reported.
impact: Ober continues to recover from right elbow inflammation after beginning a throwing program on June 11 and completing his first bullpen session Saturday without any issues. His next steps have yet to be determined, but fantasy managers should not expect him to return before July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jacob Young (side) not expected to miss significant time
desc: Jacob Young is not expected to miss significant time after missing Sunday's game against the Tampa Bay Rays.
impact: Young exited Saturday's game in the eighth inning after running into the left-center-field wall while making a catch. The issue appears to be more of a pain tolerance concern, and he is expected to avoid an injured list stint. He is considered day-to-day, with his next opportunity to play coming on Monday against the Philadelphia Phillies.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Emilio Pagan (hamstring) to throw live BP Monday
desc: Emilio Pagan is scheduled to throw a live batting practice session on Monday.
impact: Pagan threw a live batting practice session at Yankee Stadium on Friday, tossing 20 pitches. He is scheduled for another live batting practice on Monday and could begin a minor league rehab assignment shortly after if all goes well.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Pierce Johnson (elbow) expected to be activated Monday
desc: The Cincinnati Reds are expected to activate Pierce Johnson from the 15-day injured list on Monday.
impact: Johnson rejoined the Cincinnati Reds in New York on Sunday and is expected to be reinstated from the injured list Monday. He allowed one run on two hits with one strikeout in Friday's rehab appearance with Triple-A Louisville. On the season, he owns a 3.27 ERA and 1.23 WHIP with 20 strikeouts across 22 innings out of the Reds' bullpen.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Matthew Boyd (knee) to throw bullpen session Monday
desc: Matthew Boyd is scheduled to throw a bullpen session on Monday.
impact: Boyd pitched with High-A South Bend on a rehab assignment Saturday, tossing four scoreless innings on 59 pitches. He will throw a bullpen session on Monday and could come off the injured list during the Chicago Cubs' road trip from June 22-28.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Sogard (oblique) hitting and doing defensive work
desc: Nick Sogard has been doing defensive work while hitting right-handed as he continues to build up his left-handed swing. He is currently progressing through tee work and soft toss as part of his recovery and hitting progression.
impact: Sogard has been sidelined since May 31 due to a right oblique strain. He will need to be able to hit from the left side of the plate before beginning a minor league rehab assignment. He is currently expected to be activated in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Patrick Sandoval (biceps) to make next rehab start Tuesday
desc: Patrick Sandoval is scheduled to make his next rehab start with Triple-A Worcester on Wednesday.
impact: Sandoval pitched for Double-A Portland on June 17, tossing three innings of one-run ball. He is now expected to stretch out to three to four innings and around 55 pitches in his next outing. He is on track for a potential mid-July activation.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Romy Gonzalez (shoulder, hip) to undergo full workout Monday
desc: Romy Gonzalez is scheduled to undergo a full workout at Fenway Park on Monday.
impact: Gonzalez was on a rehab assignment as he continues to recover from left shoulder surgery, but was pulled from Saturday's game with Double-A Portland due to hip flexor soreness. He has returned to Boston and will undergo a full workout on Monday before the Boston Red Sox determine the next steps in his recovery.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Mickey Moniak (ankle) could be activated Tuesday
desc: Mickey Moniak completed his three scheduled minor league rehab games with Triple-A Albuquerque and could be activated from the 10-day injured list on Tuesday.
impact: Moniak appeared in three minor league rehab games over the weekend, going 1-for-13 with a double and three strikeouts. While he struggled offensively, he was able to play in three consecutive games without any issues and could return as soon as Tuesday.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jordan Beck (hamstring) runs bases Sunday
desc: Jordan Beck ran the bases before Sunday's contest against the Pittsburgh Pirates.
impact: Beck has been sidelined since May 18 due to a left hamstring strain. He has been completing running drills for most of the week and is hopeful to be cleared soon for a minor league rehab assignment.
